Definition: A control with a small box that a person turns on (checked) or off (unchecked). Each checkbox is its own yes-or-no choice.
Whether a toggle button is on (true) or off (false). For a checkbox, true means checked.
The Quorum class that every on/off button comes from. Checkbox and RadioButton are both kinds of ToggleButton.
A class whose Run action is called when a person uses a control. A checkbox also calls the behavior's Dispose action when it is unchecked.
Extra text about a control that a screen reader reads after its name. You set it with SetDescription.
The value a control starts with before a person changes it, such as a box that starts checked.
